title: Pendent
summary: PEND'ENT, adjective [Latin pendens.] Hanging; fastened at one end, the other being loose. With ribbons pendent flaring about her head. 1. Jutting over; projecting; as a pendant rock. 2. Supported abov

inlines.v: PEND'ENT, adjective [Latin pendens.] Hanging; fastened at one end, the other being loose. With ribbons pendent flaring about her head. 1. Jutting over; projecting; as a pendant rock. 2. Supported above the ground.
